Marketplace Online

💳 Online Payment Information

Accepting digital payments can make it easier for customers to pay and can help vendors maintain a record of their transactions.

Popular Digital Payment Methods

📱

UPI Payments

Vendors can accept payments through UPI using a supported bank account and UPI ID.

  • Fast digital payments
  • No need to handle cash
  • Transaction records are available
🔳

QR Code Payments

Display your UPI QR code at your stall so customers can scan it and make payments.

  • Easy for customers to scan
  • Useful for small businesses
  • Reduces cash handling
🏦

Bank Transfer

Customers or business partners can use bank-based digital payment methods where appropriate.

  • Useful for larger transactions
  • Digital transaction record
  • Directly linked with bank account

How to Start Accepting UPI Payments

1

Have a Bank Account

Keep an active bank account that can be linked with a supported UPI service.

2

Set Up UPI

Register your bank account with a supported UPI application and create your UPI ID if required.

3

Create Your QR Code

Use your payment service provider's official process to obtain your merchant or UPI QR code.

4

Display the QR Code

Place the QR code where customers can easily see and scan it.

5

Confirm the Payment

Always verify the payment in your official payment application or bank account before handing over goods.

Benefits of Digital Payments

⚡ Faster Transactions

Digital payments can make transactions quick and convenient.

📊 Transaction Records

Digital transactions provide records that can help vendors track payments.

💰 Less Cash Handling

Reduce the need to keep large amounts of cash at the vending location.

🤝 Customer Convenience

Customers can choose a convenient digital payment method.

🔐 Digital Payment Safety Tips

  • Never share your UPI PIN with anyone.
  • Your UPI PIN is generally used to authorize payments, not to receive money.
  • Always verify the payment in your own banking or payment application.
  • Do not rely only on SMS screenshots or messages as proof of payment.
  • Never scan an unknown QR code just because someone asks you to receive money.
  • Do not share OTPs, passwords or banking credentials with anyone.
  • If you suspect fraud, contact your bank or the relevant official cyber-fraud reporting channel immediately.
